objective: Increase English source-domain valid/test stability using remaining pending high-evidence Step-4 candidates, without random easy-negative padding or any Chinese blind expansion.

supervision_targets.scientific_rationale: The previous English freeze had 77 validation rows, which still triggered Step 7's small-validation guard. A 55/20/25 split plus a targeted top-up should move English validation above 100 while keeping test above 130.

selection_buckets.description: Any remaining shared contact/PGP plus text evidence; reviewer still rejects product-sample identifiers.
Remaining direct seller-facing contact candidates, kept small because previous top-up showed most leftovers lack enough seller-facing context.
A controlled slice of high-rank exact title/description clones; reviewer promotes only alias-related or seller-specific operational clones.
Hard-boundary negatives: high semantic or structural similarity without direct identifiers, dominated by templates, product boilerplate, and same-topic independent sellers.

positive: Shared seller-facing Telegram/Wickr/phone/IM/contact handle with support from cloned text, structural overlap, or coherent seller profile context.
Shared email only when clearly presented as seller contact and not as product/victim/sample account data.
Strong text-clone rows only when alias relation, migration wording, or seller-specific operational copy makes same-control evidence stronger than generic template reuse.
negative: Generic placeholders such as No Item Name / No Description Specified across unrelated sellers.
High semantic overlap caused by public product descriptions, medication boilerplate, software/book templates, leaked-data field formats, or inventory templates without identity closure.
Shared contact parser artifacts or product sample credentials, not seller identity.
uncertain: Strong content overlap without seller-specific identity closure.
Emails, URLs, account credentials, or phone-like tokens embedded in product/victim data.
Text clones that may be reseller/template reuse but cannot be confidently separated from same-controller reuse.

hard_rules: Do not label same-alias or soft-same-alias continuity rows for primary supervision in this top-up.
Do not use product sample credentials, victim data, leaked account data, or format examples as seller identity anchors.
Do not pad the English set with random easy negatives; negative additions must be hard-boundary or template-boilerplate controls.
Do not modify Chinese Step 5 queues in this expansion.
After applying labels, run Step 5 freeze and audit train/valid/test counts and seller overlap.
Step 7 semantic extraction/training still belongs on the Linux runtime after the refreeze.
